envelope.author: architect
envelope.reason: Moving C from its bootstrap home into the design records, verbatim

payload.gloss: the concept lattice C: every live concept with its anchor, gloss and factors. Its laws: one live concept per anchor, and a withdrawn concept keeps its anchor until reinstated; factors form a set, are acyclic and name live concepts, so a concept that others factor on cannot be retracted; every gloss and every reason is non-empty. The design knows nothing of plans. Only the architect writes it; a planner, implementer or assayer that meets divergence or incoherence reports it and never resolves it.
